answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded horizon that changes every epoch. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the haven of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Net effect on the orchard: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 180qk.
